geometricAlbedo.source: Denk et al. (2018), The irregular satellites of Saturn, in Enceladus and the Icy Moons of Saturn (University of Arizona Press)
geometricAlbedo.locator: Sizes are computed from absolute magnitude with an assumed albedo of 0.06 (the author's table of irregular moons, note 9)
geometricAlbedo.test: Grav et al. (2015), Table 3, measured the two small irregular moons of Saturn NEOWISE detected: Albiorix 6.2 ± 2.8% and Siarnaq 5.0 ± 1.7%. Its eleven irregular moons of Jupiter range from 2.9% to 5.7%.
geometricAlbedo.note: Nobody has measured Ymir's albedo. The color is scaled to the value its published size already assumes; a measurement replaces it.
